title: CPC-2026-4383-CA
text:
CPC-2026-4383-CA  Council Districts: Citywide
  CEQA: ENV-2020-6762-EIR; ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1;  Last Day to Act: 12-31-26
  ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2; ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD5
  Plan Area: Citywide
  Related Cases: CPC-2025-4430-CA; CPC-2025-4421-CA

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  Citywide

  PROPOSED CODE AMENDMENT:
  The Missing Middle LA (MMLA) Program proposes amendments to Chapters 1 and 1A of the Los Angeles
  Municipal Code to implement the City’s 2021–2029 Housing Element, incorporate state housing laws, and
  expand opportunities for smaller-scale for-sale and rental housing citywide. This Proposed Code Amendment
  includes:

  An update of the Open Space ordinance to establish Lot Amenity Space provisions for developments with
  fewer than six units, expand Outdoor Amenity Area provisions to apply to single-family zones, and coordinate
  related development standards.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Find and recommend the City Council find, based on the whole of the record, in the independent judgment
  of the decision maker, that the Lot Amenity Space Ordinance were assessed in the Housing Element
  Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2020-6762-EIR (SCH No. 2021010130) certified on November 29,
  2021, the previously adopted Addendum No. 1 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1) adopted on June 14, 2022,
  Addendum No. 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2) adopted December 10, 2024, and Addendum No. 5 (ENV-
  2020-6762-EIR-ADD5) (collectively, “EIR”); adopt Addendum No. 5; determine, after consideration of the
  EIR, that pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines section 15162 and 15164, no
  subsequent or supplemental EIR is required;
  2. Determine that the Proposed Ordinances are exempt from CEQA pursuant to Public Resources Code
  Sections 21080.085 and 21080.17 and Government Code Sections 65852.21(k), 66411.7(n),
  65852.28(e), 65913.4.5(b), and 66499.41(i), as applicable;
  3. Approve and recommend, pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.3 of the LAMC, that the City Council
  adopt the following amendments to LAMC Chapter 1:
  a. The establishment of the Lot Amenity Ordinance (Exhibit A.5), amending LAMC Chapter 1 Sections
  12.03 and 12.21 to define and establish Lot Amenity Space standards and to expand the definition of
  Outdoor Amenity Areas to all zones that allow residential uses;
  4. Adopt the Staff Recommendation Report as the Commission’s report on the subject; and
  5. Adopt the Findings.

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles

  Staff:  Danai Zaire, City Planner
  planning.missingmiddlela@lacity.org
  (213) 847-3709

  The next special meeting of the City Planning Commission
  will be held on Thursday, November 19, 2026 after 8:30 a.m.

  Los Angeles City Hall
  Council Chamber, Room 340
  200 North Spring Street
  Los Angeles, CA 90012
summary: The City Planning Commission would recommend citywide rules requiring lot amenity space for developments of fewer than six units and extending outdoor amenity area standards to single-family zones.
